decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry, "introduce a backoff wait on subquery retries" [ev-e0c05f8fedac], and it mostly points to PR 10959. It does not say which component does the retrying, whether the backoff is on by default or needs configuration, which settings control it, or which deployments are affected, so the open applicability aspect cannot be written as a condition. The PR description or the relevant config and docs changes are needed to say which environments are exposed.
